name: Terraform-managed authoritative DNS and Ansible setup

mentions.name: Terraform-managed authoritative DNS and Ansible setup
mentions.description: This project migrates the author's personal infrastructure to a well-documented setup, defining the authoritative DNS zones for their domains in Terraform and setting up related configurations with Ansible.
mentions.problem: Previous setups were done ad hoc without documentation and left running on hope; this work adds documented, codified infrastructure management.
mentions.audience: Personal infrastructure the author runs for their own domains
mentions.source_excerpt: Started with my main authoritative DNS for some of my domains today, still working on some Ansible setups but I have the zones down in Terraform now.
mentions.author: ibfreeekout
